note: The Atlas engine is built from the public Enntity/atlas fork at this exact commit; build.sh refuses any other tree.

upstream_candidate.note: GLM-5.3 Flash support and optimizations intended for Atlas-Inf review; not yet proposed upstream.

sparkglm_only.note: FlashKDA prefill and native sparse-MLA prefill bridges plus their build sources (scripts/dev/glm_sparse_native, research/flash-kda-prefill).

integration.note: The SparkGLM-only layer (0965f8d5) plus reviewed topic branches merged on the Enntity/atlas fork: the sparse-index key normalization race fix and other kernel race hardening, whole-block prefix sharing, KV sizing that survives a co-tenant releasing memory, the prefix-cache policy, exact prefill and decode kernels, a rank-mirrored KV admission vote, a startup settings agreement between the two nodes, prefill queue order, warm-turn overheads, an opt-in NVMe prefix tier, and a faster verify step (MoE decode kernels, fused small kernels, GEMV launches, a drafter split across both nodes, per-step commands over RDMA, verify width from drafter confidence). Most of it is intended for the upstream candidate; that branch has not been rebuilt from it yet.
